command:
set -eu
ca_tmp_dir=$(mktemp -d)
trap 'rm -rf "$ca_tmp_dir"' EXIT HUP INT TERM
umask 077
openssl req -new -x509 -newkey rsa:4096 -sha256 -nodes -days 3650 -keyout "$ca_tmp_dir/root-ca.key" -out "$ca_tmp_dir/root-ca.crt" -subj '/CN=OS Comparison Root CA' -extensions v3_ca -config /etc/pki/tls/openssl.cnf
sudo -n install -o root -g root -m 600 "$ca_tmp_dir/root-ca.key" /etc/pki/tls/private/os-comparison-root-ca.key
sudo -n install -o root -g root -m 644 "$ca_tmp_dir/root-ca.crt" /etc/pki/ca-trust/source/anchors/os-comparison-root-ca.crt
